modules.name: auth
modules.summary: Who is using the app. The Kernel owns accounts and sessions; the app only reads the current one.
notes: Visibility decides who may open the app shell. It never grants data access on its own.
The Deployment's Signup Policy, which the owner sets in the editor or with signup_policy_set, decides who may create an account.

calls.summary: Read the signed-in Runtime Actor, or the anonymous state so the app can show a sign-in button.
calls.returns: { userId, name, role }. Signed in, name is the account email and role is "member" or "owner". Signed out, { userId: "anonymous", name: "Anonymous", role: "anonymous" }

modules.name: actions
modules.summary: The only door to the database. A call names a Server Action declared in actions.json and passes its input; the Kernel authorizes the caller, binds the input and runs the action's one SQL statement.
notes: A query action returns the rows of its SELECT. Column names are exactly the ones the SELECT projects, so alias any expression the app reads.
A mutation action returns { changes, lastInsertId }. Read changed rows with a separate query.

calls.summary: Invoke one declared Server Action as the current Runtime Actor.

args.name: name
args.description: A Server Action name declared in actions.json, e.g. tasks.list

args.name: input
args.description: One value per input binding of the action, keyed by the binding's key. Defaults to {}

calls.returns: an array of row objects for a query action, { changes, lastInsertId } for a mutation action

modules.name: files
modules.summary: Small files stored by the Kernel for one Deployment. A file is private to the user who uploaded it unless the upload asked for public.
notes: Only the uploader can list or read a private file.
On a public Deployment a signed-out visitor can list and read public files. On a private Deployment any signed-in user can.
There is no HTTP download path. The SDK downloads over MCP, checks the SHA-256 and returns a Blob URL.

calls.summary: List and download every file the current actor may read.
calls.returns: an array of { id, name, type, size, visibility, createdAt, ownerId, url }. ownerId is present only on files the caller uploaded. url is a Blob URL; it keeps the type for image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/webp and image/avif and is application/octet-stream otherwise

errors.when: the file was removed or the actor may not read it

errors.message: Too many active transfers. Cancel completed transfers before starting another.

the downloaded bytes do not match the SHA-256 the Kernel announced
